_scored_by: Repo owner, 2026-10-18 (drafted by Claude, adopted by the repo owner; decisions.md O59)

measurable_in_customer_data.rationale: Inpatient Encounters with a non-obstetric reason; records-only customers see only their own hospitals.

actionable.rationale: The classic care-management enrolment signal; includes planned stays (surgery), so it's broader than avoidable admissions.

lead_time.rationale: 12-month horizon from a year of history: weeks to months to act for most patients; little lead time for events in the first weeks.

fhir_representability.rationale: A 12-month event probability maps directly onto RiskAssessment.prediction.probabilityDecimal (O3).

regulatory_posture.rationale: Population-level planning aid reviewed by a clinician, with its basis shown (per-patient narratives); not time-critical, not a diagnosis. Same posture for all four; to be confirmed by regulatory review before Phase 8b.
